definitions.full: H4198. mazeh [ מָזֶה ] adjective (si vera lectio) sucked out, empty , רָעָב מְזֵי Deut 32:24 sucked out, empty, front hunger (|| רֶשֶׁף לְחֻמֵי ) so Isa 5:13 Ew De Che Di Du (for מְתֵי ᵑ0 ; מֵתֵי ᵑ9 ᵐ5 ).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to suck out ;
